enemies.description: 6 aquatic enemy types, 4 animation frames each
enemies.original_prompt: Generate a sprite sheet of retro arcade space-invasion enemy sprites for a Galaga-style game, but with an AQUATIC / deep-sea alien theme. LAYOUT: 6 rows x 4 columns on a solid pure black background. Each row is one unique aquatic enemy; the 4 columns in that row are its 4 animation frames shown left-to-right. All cells exactly the same size (256x256 px), evenly spaced, no text, no labels, no borders between cells. Square image 1024 wide x 1536 tall. STYLE: crisp 16-bit neo-arcade pixel art, underwater bioluminescent neon colors (cyan, teal, magenta, poison-green, orange) glowing against dark abyss-black. Sharp hard edges, NO anti-aliasing, NO gradients, flat shading with one highlight + one shadow step, high contrast, symmetrical, front-facing, no perspective. Consistent style across every sprite. Each enemy centered in its cell with consistent scale. Add glowing accent cores/eyes. 1px dark rim outline so sprites pop off black. ROWS (top to bottom), 4 distinct loopable frames each: 1. Pufferfish (spiky round fish) - puff cycle: small -> mid -> big with spikes out -> mid 2. Flying Mantis Crab (hovering crustacean with big pincers) - pincers: open -> closing -> snap shut -> opening 3. Jellyfish (dome with trailing tentacles) - tentacle sway: phase 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 4. Anglerfish (dark fish with glowing lure on stalk and big toothy jaw) - jaw: open -> biting -> closed -> lure flicker 5. Mech-Shark / Orca (sleek armored fast diver) - fin flick + mouth open/close cycle, 4 poses 6. Sea Dragon (horned serpent-like beast with small tentacles) - tentacle wave + horn glow pulse, 4 phases. Frames within each row must be clearly distinct but smoothly sequential (loopable). Keep it clean and croppable.

bosses.description: 3 large boss creatures, 4 animation frames each
bosses.original_prompt: Now generate a sprite sheet of 3 huge retro arcade BOSS sprites for the SAME game, continuing the exact same AQUATIC / deep-sea alien theme and pixel-art style as the enemy sheet above (same neon palette, same black background, same crisp 16-bit look). These are large menacing final-boss creatures, bigger and more detailed than the regular enemies. LAYOUT: 3 rows x 4 columns on a solid pure black background. Each row is one unique boss; the 4 columns in that row are its 4 animation frames shown left-to-right. All cells exactly the same size (512x512 px), evenly spaced, no text, no labels, no borders between cells. Image 2048 wide x 1536 tall. STYLE: identical to the enemy sheet - crisp 16-bit neo-arcade pixel art, underwater bioluminescent neon colors (cyan, teal, magenta, poison-green, orange, red) glowing against dark abyss-black. Sharp hard edges, NO anti-aliasing, NO gradients, flat shading with highlight + shadow steps, high contrast, symmetrical, front-facing, no perspective. Glowing accent eyes/cores. 1px dark rim outline. Large intimidating bosses filling most of each cell. ROWS (top to bottom), 4 distinct loopable frames each: 1. GIANT EVIL OCTOPUS - massive purple/magenta octopus with many long writhing tentacles, huge glowing red eyes, menacing open maw with teeth. Frames: tentacle spread cycle (wide -> mid -> tight -> mid). 2. MEGALODON LEVIATHAN SHARK - colossal armored cyan/teal mega-shark with metallic plating, glowing green eyes, rows of huge teeth, dorsal fin. Frames: jaw open/close + fin flick cycle (closed -> opening -> wide open -> closing). 3. ABYSSAL KRAKEN DREADNOUGHT - enormous dark teal kraken with thick armored tentacles, multiple glowing orange eyes, crown of spikes, central glowing core. Frames: tentacle wave + core glow pulse cycle (phase 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4). Frames within each row must be clearly distinct but smoothly sequential (loopable). Keep it clean and croppable, consistent scale so all three read as same-tier bosses matching the enemy sheet style.

powerups.description: 4 collectible power-up capsules (bubbly sausage/popper style), 4 inflate/squeeze frames each
powerups.original_prompt: Make a NEW sprite sheet of 4 power-up items. IMPORTANT: these must be BUBBLY SAUSAGE / POPPER shapes - like a plump inflated pill or party-cracker with a small TIED KNOT/BAND on EACH END (like a tied sausage link). Round glossy gelatinous body with a bright highlight. NOT ornate badges - simple round bubbly capsules. LAYOUT: 4 rows x 4 columns, pure black background, each cell 256x256px, evenly spaced, no text/borders. Image 1024x1024. CRITICAL ANIMATION: Each row must show 4 CLEARLY DIFFERENT frames of a squeeze/inflate cycle: frame 1 = fully inflated (fat/round), frame 2 = slightly squished, frame 3 = most squished (thin/wide), frame 4 = slightly squished. The capsule visibly changes shape between frames. Do NOT make all 4 frames identical. STYLE: same crisp 16-bit neon pixel art as the enemy/boss sheets above, black bg, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, flat shading + highlight, glowing center icon, 1px dark rim. ROWS top to bottom: 1. CYAN capsule, tied knots both ends, center icon = shield hexagon 2. YELLOW/GOLD capsule, tied knots both ends, center icon = three arrows fanning up 3. PURPLE capsule, tied knots both ends, center icon = hourglass 4. RED/ORANGE capsule, tied knots both ends, center icon = bomb/explosion star. Each row: 4 distinct inflate/squeeze frames. Clean and croppable.

player.description: Player hero ship - Manta Ray fighter viewed from below, 4 wing-fin animation frames

entities.name: Manta Ray Hero
entities.colors: brown/bronze body, blue/cyan gradient wing tips, bioluminescent dots, cyan cockpit glow
entities.anim: wing fins: spread wide->swept back->most swept->swept back

player.original_prompt: Generate a sprite sheet of the PLAYER HERO ship for this same aquatic Galaga game. Same 16-bit neon pixel-art style and black background as the other sheets. THE HERO: A sleek MANTA RAY fighter craft, viewed from BELOW (so we see its underside), pointing UP (nose at top). It has wide sweeping wings/fins that look like a spaceship when seen from below. Exotic color scheme: brown/bronze body with a blue/cyan gradient toward the wing tips, scattered small glowing dots (bioluminescent spots) across the body. A bright cyan cockpit/core glow in the center. Two small thruster glows at the rear. LAYOUT: 1 row x 4 columns on pure black background. The 4 columns are 4 animation frames showing the manta ray's wing fins flapping/swimming: frame 1 = wings fully spread wide, frame 2 = wings slightly swept back, frame 3 = wings most swept (narrow), frame 4 = wings slightly swept back. Subtle but clearly distinct fin positions between frames. Each cell 256x256px, evenly spaced, no text/borders. Image 1024x256 pixels. STYLE: crisp 16-bit neo-arcade pixel art, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, flat shading + highlight steps, high contrast, symmetrical, front-facing (from below looking up). Glowing accents. 1px dark rim outline. The manta should read clearly as a fast elegant player ship.

background.description: Static scrolling backdrop - dark biomech deep-sea abyss, tileable horizontally
background.content: biomech tower silhouettes, kelp tendrils, bioluminescent nodes, depth gradient
background.constraints: below 20% brightness, tileable horizontally, black top to dark teal bottom
background.original_prompt: Now generate a BACKGROUND image for the SAME aquatic Galaga game, matching the exact same 16-bit neo-arcade pixel-art style and neon palette as the enemy/boss/powerup sheets above. This is a dark atmospheric deep-sea backdrop that bright sprites will be drawn on top of. CONTENT: A vast underwater abyss scene. Distant biomech alien structures - huge silhouettes of organic-mechanical towers, coral-like spires, and tentacle-wrapped pillars in the far background (very dim). Mid-ground has swaying kelp tendrils and scattered bioluminescent nodes (dim glowing dots in cyan/magenta). Overall mood: dark, mysterious, deep ocean. CRITICAL RULES: Keep EVERYTHING VERY DARK (below 20% brightness) so bright neon sprites pop against it. The background must NOT compete with foreground sprites. Color palette limited to: near-black, very dark teal, deep purple, faint dim cyan. NO bright colors. No text, no borders, no UI elements. Pure black at the top fading to very dark teal/navy at the bottom (depth gradient). Tileable horizontally (left and right edges should match seamlessly for parallax scrolling). DIMENSIONS: 1024 wide x 640 tall pixels (matching the game canvas aspect ratio). Style: crisp 16-bit pixel art, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, flat shading, consistent with the other sheets.
